$comment: PROPOSAL ONLY -- structure and rules, with an empty register. No exemption in this file is in force; each entry requires its own authoritative receipt. An AI agent or repository author MUST NOT add an entry here.

who_may_approve.$comment: To be decided by Human/Ops. Proposed: a named Legal/Security/Risk principal, authenticated in an external system. A role string alone is never sufficient.
who_may_approve.proposed: named principal holding an authorised Legal/Security/Risk role, resolvable in the authoritative source system

required_binding.$comment: Every exemption must bind to all of these. A missing field fails closed.

permanent_or_global_exemptions.$comment: A blanket exemption that names no package/finding defeats the gate.

revocation.proposed: the issuing principal or any higher authority may revoke; revocation takes effect on the next gate run

fail_closed_on: authoritative source system unreachable or reference unresolvable

receipt_requirements.$comment: Mirrors the OSS handoff receipt contract so an exemption is verifiable the same way a policy approval is.
never_acceptable: role-only string such as Human/Ops or Legal with no named principal
repository-local JSON with no external authoritative readback
exemption not bound to a package, license or finding
